name: Origami Emergency Shelter City
description: A refugee camp of elegant origami shelters — each folded from a single sheet of waterproof, insulated material — unfolding into homes with built-in gardens, water collection, and solar cells, glowing warmly at dusk.
prompt: Vast settlement of elegant origami emergency shelters at twilight, each folded from single sheet of advanced material — white with subtle geometric patterns, unfolding into complete homes with integrated garden pockets, water collection folds, flexible solar cell surfaces, warm golden light glows from within each shelter, arranged in organic community clusters with shared spaces, people silhouettes moving between, sense of dignity and hope, innovative humanitarian design, 8k, aerial view showing beautiful geometry
caption:
Folded with care. Unfolded into home. 🏠✨

One sheet. Infinite possibility. This is what shelter looks like.
